# Sina / 怡采强档 — Chinese campaign walkthrough continuation

- Original source: [怡采＿罗宾攻略](https://games.sina.com.cn/zhqu/ycqd/luobingong0403_2.shtml)
- Author / publication: 新浪游戏 / 怡采强档 (Yicai special section; page footer names 武汉怡采科技有限公司, the Chinese distributor); no individual author shown.
- Language / date: Simplified Chinese; no publication date shown (Chinese release listed as February 2003).
- Access: Full page retrieved directly (guide page 2, missions 9-23, ending and forest building)
- Checked: 2026-09-09

- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes in English (Chinese walkthrough, not transcribed)

The continuation combines story summaries, objectives, suggested routes, and scroll explanations. Inspected sections cover defense preparation, the archery contest, Marian’s wedding, an ambush, and Robin’s rescue. Its numbering includes forest encounters, unlike guides that number only major story missions.

A wedding passage recommends reaching the church from the northern tower and drawing guards toward the rear entrance. The defense discussion uses a descriptive shield metaphor and mixes several campaign situations, so its terminology needs comparison with other guides. Its structure and wording differ from the previously collected yago/Ali213 guide; common authorship or republication elsewhere remains unverified.

## Detailed notes

Retrieved directly on 2026-09-09. No licence; the Simplified Chinese text is summarised in English, with original terms where useful.

Section navigation on the page: 专区首页, 游戏简介, 故事背景, 人物角色, 操作指南, 攻略秘籍, 精美图片, 相关下载. The sidebar also advertises other Yicai titles (No One Lives Forever 2, Iron Storm, Inquisition) and introduces Robin Hood as a German-made real-time tactics game in the mould of Commandos.

Each mission entry has four parts: 剧情攻略 (story), 任务提示 (objectives), 流程攻略 (walkthrough) and 卷轴提示 (scroll hints). This page continues from Mission 9; Missions 1-8 are on page 1 (not part of this file).

### Mission 9: The King's Sceptre (国王的权杖)

- Story: Marian hears Prince John has come to Derby and wants to find a way to rescue King Richard; the Sheriff has sent many men to protect the prince. Sneaking into Derby, the party finds the prince and nobles meeting on the castle's top floor. Outside the council room Marian overhears that England is asked for a ransom of 100,000 pounds for Richard, and that John and the Sheriff intend to ignore it and make John king. Robin decides to raise the ransom himself and, since the sceptre symbolising royal authority is in the castle, to take it so the plotters are stalled.
- Objectives: eavesdrop on Prince John's council; find and seize the King's sceptre.
- Walkthrough: clear the guards outside the Derby gate. A beggar by the gate sells a map of the forces inside the castle. Go up the ladder left of the gate into the castle. The stairway to the top floor is by the inner left wall, heavily guarded: lure enemies out to avoid group fights, then go up. Clear the guards outside but do not enter the council room or the story will not advance; gather Robin and Marian at the door to trigger the scene. Leaving, a scroll appears saying the sceptre is in the hall to the right. Go down and attack the hall to get the sceptre, without alerting the archer squad below. Retreat the way you came and walk to the bottom of the map to finish.
- Scroll hints: Marian must be present to eavesdrop; only the left-hand line of enemies inside the castle must be dealt with, most others can be avoided; the sceptre is in the castle hall and well guarded.

### Mission 10: Raising the Ransom (筹集赎金)

- Story: the sceptre has been taken but John has started large-scale searches; the ransom must be raised by robbing convoys of nobles passing through Sherwood.
- Objective: rob the tax money.
- Walkthrough: the easiest ambush level: have a few characters draw the enemy's attention, then send someone to take the money.
- Scroll hint: protect the sceptre, but raising the ransom quickly matters more.

### Mission 11: The Brave Man (坚强的勇敢者)

- Story: during another robbery, in the familiar village, Robin meets a brave man being punished by the Sheriff's thugs for resisting: Little John. He must be rescued.
- Objective: rescue the brave man John.
- Walkthrough: relatively hard; lure enemies out and defeat them one by one. There is a strong knight whom ordinary attacks cannot hurt; only Robin can attack him directly, and after he is stunned only a character with the harpoon/pitchfork (鱼叉) can kill him. After rescuing John return to Sherwood by the same route.
- Scroll hints: none.

### Mission 12: The Surrenderer (投降者)

- Story: Ranulph writes asking Robin to come to his castle, the one where Will was held. Because the meeting is secret Robin must sneak in, avoid patrols, and persuade Ranulph, who also helps him obtain the special item, the Domesday Book (spelled "Dommsday Book").
- Objectives: reach Ranulph without harming anyone; get the Domesday Book; leave the castle without harming anyone.
- Walkthrough: nobody may be harmed, so exclude characters whose attacks kill. Little John is recommended: his staff, using straight attacks and not the spin, stuns without killing. Alternatively let Robin or Little John fight while the other stuns from the side, then have someone with the tying ability bind the enemy; if enemies are numerous, pull a stun-capable character out of the melee to use the stun skill. Two routes: assault as in Will's rescue (not recommended), or use the secret passage from outside the castle used to leave last time, which avoids many enemies. Inside, pay the beggar right of the church for the situation on the right tower. Stun the surrounding enemies, go up the left stairway into the room to meet Ranulph; after he surrenders a new red scroll appears; go up the left tower for the Domesday Book. Exit to the south through the main gate by cutting the rope above it.
- Scroll hints: there are many ways in, but deal with the enemies on the right tower first; the Domesday Book is important, take it before leaving.

### Mission 13: Godwin's Castle (Godwin的城堡)

- Story: shocking news from Nottingham: "Cuisbourne" (Gisbourne) has rebelled and imprisoned the lord Godwin. A beggar outside says Godwin is in the Nottingham dungeon, surrounded by hard rock and reachable only from inside. Godwin is wounded and cannot leave; he sends word for loyal soldiers to cooperate with Robin. Nottingham is retaken, but Gisbourne escapes.
- Objectives: find Godwin; take Nottingham.
- Walkthrough: find the beggar outside for Godwin's location. Entry point is on the right of the map: clear the enemies outside, climb over the wall. Going left returns to the starting position of the game's first level; climb the left wall and head toward the dungeon. Have the character with the harpoon/pitchfork open the dungeon door to reach Godwin. He summons loyal men: find the four scrolls scattered in the castle to bring those soldiers to your side. Eliminate all enemies to win.
- Scroll hints: Godwin can only be in the dungeon at the very bottom of the castle; use the scrolls to rally the castle's soldiers for the counterattack.

### Mission 14: The Rich Man in the Village (村庄里的富人)

- Story: a very rich man has arrived in the village; now is when he has the fewest protectors.
- Objective: seize the gold.
- Walkthrough: not difficult once the enemy's heavy swordsman and knight are dealt with.
- Scroll hints: none.

### Mission 15: The Friar's Call (神甫的召唤)

- Story: Marian tells Robin that the friar who once helped her has been captured by "Scathlock" of Derby. Derby is heavily guarded; a Robin admirer outside the gate says information may be found near the hall. Robin and Will go in together. The friar is found hanging in the air at the castle's upper right, starved; once freed he says Prince John is still here. Eavesdropping outside the council room reveals a plot to make Godwin trade his lands for the king. The party leaves Derby under darkness.
- Objective: rescue the friar.
- Walkthrough: same entry point as the previous Derby visit; clear the men outside the gate first; inside there are very many archers, so kill them before they notice you; more archers inside the inner area. After clearing everyone go up the right tower to rescue the friar, then go with him to eavesdrop outside the council room, and leave by the same route.
- Scroll hints: the friar's skills are light-weight tricks, such as using a beehive as a weapon; the friar has a good reputation among soldiers, who gladly accept water he offers, though the water is a little "off".

### Note on power-shield missions

The guide explains it treats the "collect three power shields" (力量之盾) requirement as a single mission for narrative convenience: one shield represents one small task, and sometimes one task yields several shields.

### Mission 16: The Power to Counterattack (反攻的力量)

- Story: John and the Sheriff are enraged; forces are massing at Lincoln and elsewhere to attack Robin, while Godwin's side prepares to rescue the king. Robin must re-muster all forces before John's army assembles.
- Objective: collect three power shields.
- Walkthrough: clicking the mission on the Sherwood map opens a map with three icons at the bottom: the first assembles all your men, the second is purchase, the third is a mission. These are the three ways to get shields: (1) forest robberies and interception actions that destroy enemies on the map; (2) buying with money, but the price rises with each purchase; (3) mustering your troops to attack a city and take shields from the enemy. The guide recommends the first: ambush levels are easy and you can grab the shield without prolonged fighting. The three methods can be switched and combined. Buying works once but later collections become troublesome; a full assault costs heavy losses. Each shield has three possible locations, and after each is taken all three refresh. Three consecutive attacks yield enough shields. After the first collection the guide no longer recommends only fighting, because the number of shields needed grows. The second collection takes place in Derby: it is not about shield count; shield-shaped markers appear in the castle, and clearing the enemies near each yields it. After clearing the castle, go to the top floor, talk to the last man (Robin must go) and defeat him to win.
- Scroll hints: none.

### Mission 17: Marian's Kiss (Marian之吻)

- Story: since the friar's rescue Marian, still in Nottingham, is watched by the Sheriff. An archery contest is announced with Marian's kiss as the prize. Robin sneaks in disguised, wins, is recognised by the Sheriff, beats him in a sword duel, escapes the soldiers, finds Marian, and with her help finds several more people willing to join Sherwood; he also takes the Sword of Power (权利之剑) from the church before returning.
- Objectives: win the archery contest; defeat the Sheriff; find three companions with Marian; take the Sword of Power and leave.
- Walkthrough: after winning, the Sheriff comes down to duel Robin; after he is beaten many soldiers rush in. Deal with them, then go up the left stairs to where Marian is. After the conversation Marian can go up one more floor to fetch healing herbs. The first companion appears beside Marian's house; he says two more can join, one by the right wall and one below the stairs of the north wall. When finding them lure enemies out, since fighting all at once costs a lot. After finding both you may leave directly or go to the church for the Sword of Power. Leave the castle and return to Sherwood by the right-hand road.
- Scroll hints: none.

A second shield-collection mission follows, played the same way as before.

### Mission 18: The Shameless Wedding (无耻的婚姻)

- Story: after Robin escapes Nottingham, John plans to marry Marian to Guisbourne. The wedding is heavily guarded inside and out; a beggar says many enemies are gathered near the church. After a hard fight to the church Guisbourne intervenes and is defeated; Robin is lightly wounded; Marian tells everyone to leave, and the way out has been cleared.
- Objective: stop Marian's wedding.
- Walkthrough: many enemies from the start; moving everyone at once gets you spotted. Send Robin alone first to defeat the wandering enemies and get all information from the beggar, then move as a group. Do not use the church's front door: there is a door at the back of the church, and its entrance is in the tower of the north gate; from there you reach the rear of the church. Lure enemies one by one to the back door and finish them, never too many at once; clear those outside, then slowly those inside. Then send Robin in; Guisbourne comes up to duel; kill him, talk to Marian, wait for her to change clothes, and leave the castle together.
- Scroll hints: many enemies are placed around the church, a frontal attack is hard to win; the north tower has a secret passage leading to the church.

### Mission 19: The Clever Robbery (巧妙的抢劫)

- Story: life in Sherwood is calm again; robbing tax carts is still part of life.
- Objective: seize the tax money.
- Walkthrough: troublesome because of a black knight, but there is a clever approach: just take the money and ignore the enemies. Character number 3 is placed closest to the money; have the others draw away the enemies near it, then send number 3 straight in to take it.
- Scroll hints: none.

### Mission 20: The Prison (囚牢)

- Story: Robin's movements were scouted and he was captured and imprisoned in Nottingham. Marian leads the Sherwood members to rescue him. A prisoner in the jail outside the city says Robin is in the prison inside the castle. The castle gate is closed; entry is only from the north. Marian rescues Robin.
- Objectives: rescue Robin; rescue the prisoner being displayed publicly.
- Walkthrough: the first jail is outside the castle on the left: clear the guards outside and enter; inside is a black knight; after defeating him talk to the prisoner for Robin's location. Then attack the castle, which has many enemies: do not move everyone together, send one character you are comfortable with. A beggar at the castle gate, when paid, asks you to save the man being publicly displayed in the city; saving him on the square outside the inner castle gives a reward. Then go north and enter from the north wall; go straight to the prison tower to free Robin. Leave through the main gate: send someone to cut the rope in the room below the castle so the gate opens, then get everyone out.
- Scroll hints: the man displayed on the square is a poor wretch, be sure to save him; to rescue Robin you must search inside the castle.

### Mission 21: John's Plot (John的阴谋)

- Story: Allan writes urging Robin to come to York. At night Robin meets Allan, who says John is holding a secret meeting there. Eavesdropping, Robin learns the captive Richard's ransom must be paid within a month, but John refuses and has Longchamps write that not a penny will be paid, putting Longchamps in charge. After John leaves, Robin storms in and kills Longchamps; Allan arrives and is told to put on Longchamps' clothes and keep up appearances, while Robin's party carries away the body so no trace remains. They leave York under cover of night.
- Objectives: meet Allan; eavesdrop on John's council; stop Longchamps' plan; carry away Longchamps' body.
- Walkthrough: the party starts outside the castle; Allan is at the southernmost gate. Send Robin alone; apart from a few unavoidable enemies, rush past while they are turned away. After meeting Allan return to the start and enter via the north tower; Robin and characters who can jump go in. On the way to the council room is the royal seal (王权之章), be sure to take it. Eavesdrop from the room right of the council room; John leaves; Robin enters and duels Longchamps. After the kill Allan comes to take the clothes; Robin cuts the rope at the castle gate to let the team in; a character with carrying ability carries the body. Protect the carrier on the way out, as he moves very slowly; others should not run ahead or trailing soldiers will engage him. Everyone withdraws through the east gate to win.
- Scroll hints: none.

Next come two ambush levels and one shield level, played as before; only the shield level is described.

### Mission 22: The Battle for York (York攻防战)

- Story: Godwin's allied army attacks York but is in trouble and needs Robin's help to break in. Robin's party opens three gates so Godwin's army can take the city.
- Objectives: open the three main gates; eliminate the enemies on the two main bridges; raise your flag on top of the castle; ring the victory bell in the church.
- Walkthrough: shield markers in the castle show what to attack; the guide suggests the three gates first, then the council room; hang the flag, then go to the church. The order is free.
- Scroll hints: replace the enemy flag with your own on the castle top; ring the victory bell in the church.

Next are a mandatory ambush level and a shield level (completed via three small ambushes), neither difficult.

### Mission 23: Robin's Judgement (Robin的裁决)

- Story: John, no longer tolerating Robin, comes to Nottingham to personally oversee wiping out Sherwood, which is the best chance to capture him and trade him for Richard. Robin splits the members into three groups attacking from different directions to divide attention. Robin gets in, kills the Sheriff, and John surrenders and becomes Robin's prisoner. Richard returns to England.
- Objectives: capture John; kill the Sheriff.
- Walkthrough: the enemy count is the main headache and cannot be avoided; bows are vital, and use the resurrection flower (复活之花). Entry is again on the north wall, where a soldier will help you. Reach the door of the castle centre, have a lock-picker open it, then Robin goes straight up to the central council room and kills the Sheriff; John is captured.
- Scroll hints: none.

### Ending

In Sherwood Robin moves through the forest as usual but meets a formidable opponent and is knocked down; he calls out the king's name; the opponent removes his mask: King Richard has returned, and Robin swears eternal loyalty to him in Sherwood.

### Forest building (森林建造)

After the first two missions every mission starts in Sherwood, the base for all supplies. Everyone in Sherwood takes part in building tasks. Tasks differ by area and new ones appear (marked by a new blue scroll) when characters with different abilities join. Anyone can help with any task, but the products can only be used by specific roles; finished products are placed outside the production spot for the right character to pick up.

| Task | Product / purpose | Corresponding characters |
|---|---|---|
| 烧肉 (roast meat) | cooks wild animals into meat for healing | peasant ("农蛮"), Friar Tuck |
| 补血草 (healing herbs) | gathers and processes herbs for healing | "fisherman" (渔夫), Marian |
| 补血草加工 (herb processing) | for processing gathered herbs; the author never saw it produce anything | unknown |
| 弓箭 (arrows) | makes arrows from wood; the number of arrows per quiver varies | archer, Marian, Robin Hood |
| 水 (water) | a lure for thirsty enemies | Friar Tuck |
| 苹果 (apples) | collected as a throwing weapon | "fisherman", Stutely |
| 金子 (gold) | mined and bagged as a lure for enemies | Robin Hood |
| 渔网 (fishing net) | thrown to net enemies like fish; good group weapon | Stutely |
| 蜂巢 (beehive) | thrown; enemies dodge; no damage, only disruption | Friar Tuck |
| 石头 (stones) | shaped into a usable weapon | Will Scarlet |

Terminology note: the guide's "渔夫" (fisherman) and "鱼叉" (harpoon) refer to the pitchfork-wielding peasant class; "Cuisbourne" and "Guisbourne" both mean Guy of Gisbourne; "Scathlock" appears as the name of the Derby captor.
